title: The posting entry set, the posting type mapping and the rule of the posting of a settlement or a sale route are in no read source
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.7; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md (R-SET-14, R-SET-18, R-DIS-54); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-047)
description: The feature posts the accounting entries of settlements, sales and write-offs to the ledger, and no source in the read set gives the entry set of a route, the chart-of-accounts reference it debits and credits, the posting type a match value maps to, or the identifier of the rule row that governs the posting of a settlement or a sale receipt. The FSD A2.7.4.1 writes the criterion one epic ahead and its rule table carries VR-P8-007-1 and BR-P8-007 only; the routing logic gives the posting rules of the debt-sale and write-off routes (R-DS-31, R-WO-21) and none for the settlement or the sale.
evidence: FSD P8 A2.7.3.1 lists VR-P8-007-1 and BR-P8-007 only; FSD P8 AC-P8-007-01 reads 'The result is recorded with its rule version' with no rule ID; R-SET-14 and R-DIS-54 say 'match the payment and post it' with no entry set
proposed: Hold the entry set and the posting type mapping as data of the ledger interface configuration, and publish the posting rule of the settlement and sale routes from the rule registry of rwb-decision

title: The trigger and the posting window of the feature are not stated for this service
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.7.2, A2.7.4; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T5.1
description: The FSD gives the trigger of the feature as 'a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer' and the technical specification of the same module gives the GL interface as a monthly file (INT-16) and the ALS booking as confirmed on the next day's load (INT-03). No source says whether this service posts on the match, on a batch completion, on a month-end close window, or on all three, and the legacy story says only that the work runs as a service or a scheduled job.
evidence: FSD P8 A2.7.2 step 1: 'Receives its trigger: a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer'; TSD P8 T5.1: INT-16 GL in, file load, monthly; INT-03 ALS out, confirmed on the next day's load; legacy RWB-E4-047 Endpoints: None
proposed: Post at the match in the calling run and confirm on the batch completion of the source, with no Schedule and no window of this service

title: The field that carries the posting reference, and the read that serves it, are named in no contract
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T3.1 (DF-FIN-009); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.7
description: DF-FIN-009 gives `posting_ref` as varchar(40), optional, sourced from the core bank through COLLINS, and the data dictionary maps it to the ACE payment record with the instruction 'confirm as the posting reference'. No source gives the operation, path or field list of the read that serves it in the target, and no source says whether the GL reference and the ALS reference are the same value.
evidence: TSD P8 T3.1 DF-FIN-009 source 'Core bank (ALS) via COLLINS'; LDM v8 mapping row DF-FIN-009 'ACE reuse, payment.pay_key, v_ace_payment.payment_code, Confirm as the posting reference'; TSD P8 T5.2 names only the published interfaces of P3 to P7
proposed: Publish the posting-reference read in the P1 contract epic with the payment code, the business date, the reference and the batch status, and confirm the mapping with the solution architect

title: The event catalogue holds no posting-result event, so a confirmed posting is announced nowhere
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Event and Messaging Design v4.md (EV-01 to EV-30); _work/msr/context/P8.md (events EV-11, EV-12, EV-25)
description: The catalogue names 26 published events and none of them reports a posting or its reference; EV-24 WriteOffApproved names Posting as its consumer, which is the input of a posting and not its result. A consumer that needs to know that a receipt was posted, such as the reporting read model or the route service that raised the posting, can only read it back on the service's operation.
evidence: Event and Messaging Design v4 Events sheet: EV-24 payload writeOffId, caseId, amount with consumer Posting; no event holds postingId, postingRef or a posting state
proposed: Add no event in this run; if rwb-reporting or a route service needs the fact, raise PostingConfirmed with the event catalogue in the next version

title: The ledger interface values, its layout, its result codes and its retry schedule are not published
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T5.1; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v4.md JOB-09; _work/msr/context/P8.md
description: TSD P8 gives INT-16 GL as a monthly file load and INT-03 ALS as booked by the officer and confirmed on the next day's load, and JOB-09 file loads is retired under D-RCV-35 because ACE ingests the GL and ALS files. No source gives the interface identifier, the transport, the layout, the result codes, the retry intervals or the message text that this service's posting item obeys, and those values are rwb-integration's interface configuration.
evidence: TSD P8 T5.1: INT-16 GL in, file load, monthly; INT-03 ALS out; Batch and Scheduling Design v4 JOB-09: retired, ACE ingestion; no interface id, layout or result code in any read source
proposed: Load the GL and ALS interface rows as interface configuration of rwb-integration, with their retry values and message text, and keep MSG-P2-001's wording in the message standard

title: The integration story assigns a payments read to rwb-payment that its ownership rows do not hold
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-ITG-W3 Wave 3 integration/RWB ITG E4047 ITG Post to the general ledger - integration v1.md section 12.2; _work/msr/context/P8.md (REST operations provided, 2); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P8 Payments and posting v2.md T-A.1
description: The wave 3 harness reads the payments of a case with `GET /api/recovery/payment/v1/cases/{caseId}/payments` and names rwb-payment as its owner, while the ownership rows of P8 list two provided operations and TSD P8 T-A.1 lists API-P8-001 and API-P8-002 only. Either the operation exists and the ownership rows and the API specification are incomplete, or the harness names an operation that no owner declares.
evidence: Context pack P8: REST operations provided GET /proceeds and POST /proceeds/{proceedsId}/match; TSD P8 T-A.1 the same two; ITG story section 12.2 lists the cases/{caseId}/payments read as P8's, and section 4 step 3 calls it
proposed: Add the payments read to the ownership rows and the API specification, or correct the harness to read the receipts through GET /proceeds with its case filter

title: The rejection of a posting is a route state for the debt sale and the write-off and has no stated owner for a settlement or a sale receipt
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md (R-DS-32, R-DS-33, R-WO-22, R-WO-23); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3.md A2.7
description: R-DS-32 and R-WO-22 hold the posting and raise an exception task and move the debt-sale and write-off cases to POSTING_REJECTED; R-DS-33 and R-WO-23 re-post. No rule of the settlement or asset-sale route says what happens when the ledger rejects its posting, whether the case moves, and whether the receipt is re-posted from this service or from the interface's exception queue.
evidence: Routing logic v4: R-DS-32, R-DS-33 in the debt sale route set and R-WO-22, R-WO-23 in the write-off set; no POSTING_REJECTED row in the settlement or the asset disposal set
proposed: Keep the rejection as an exception item of the interface row with its retry and resend, and let the route service own any case state it wants to raise

title: Two consumed reads are class C in fact while the plan's contract row for the key is None
source: WP B2-P8-011 story JSON (C []); Template and Rules v1 R5.4 and R5.5; _work/msr/context/P8.md
description: The posting step consumes the posting-reference read of rwb-source-data and the rule-in-force read of rwb-decision, each of them another service's contract, and reads the case label through the composite route; the plan carries no C row for this key, so nothing records the two contract dependencies the build actually has.
evidence: The WP JSON gives C [] for the story; the flow of section 4 needs the reference and the rule version to satisfy legacy AC1 and AC2
proposed: Add the two C rows to the plan, or keep the reads as consumed and faked from Day 1 as this story does
